summary: Defaulted the streamable-HTTP MCP bind address to 127.0.0.1:7777 instead of :7777.
reason: Binding all interfaces triggers Windows firewall prompts and exposes the MCP server to the LAN; loopback is the safe default for a local tool. Mirrors the identical fix already staged in the greenhouse package; multi-CLI template bug.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; .mcpb bundle rebuilt with the fixed binary.
